0.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_001
0.description: Ye've come to the Wolves' Den, maggot! If ye've got business with me, state it loud and clear!

1.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_002
1.description: Here to train, are ye? Well, I've laid in a few trinkets for ye sniveling sissies to rip each other's guts out over. Don't say I don't give ye maggots the proper motivation! To the victor, the spoils!

2.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_003
2.description: Hmmm... I know that hungry gleam in yer eye, and I know the scuffles them other pups enjoy ain't enough to sate yer appetite.

3.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_004
3.description: Ye need to sink yer fangs into the meat at the Feast! Lend me yer ear, and I'll soon have yer belly rumblin' with anticipation!

10.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_Q2_000_000
10.description: What do you wish to know about the Feast?

11.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_A2_100_001
11.description: How do I join the Feast?

15.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_Q3_000_000
15.description: Which rules will you ask about?

24.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_Q4_000_000
24.description: What part of PvP rating will you ask about?

30.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_010
30.description: The Wolves' Den is a battle arena built by the Maelstrom to train Alliance soldiers into an elite fighting force! Here, pups at the teat are made into fearsome hunters!

31.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_11
31.description: The Wolves' Den is a PvP arena which hosts battles between adventurers.

33.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_100_12
33.description: Players can elect to participate in the Feast, wherein they can take part in training matches with two teams of eight or ranked matches with two teams of four.

34.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_13
34.description: To register for a match at the Wolves' Den, open the Duty Finder and select it from the PvP category.

42.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_030
42.description: Only a special breed of wolf gets invited to the Feast! Will ye gorge on the flesh at the table? Or find yerself served on a platter!?

43.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_031
43.description: Participants in the Feast are divided into two teams, with each team attempting to seize medals from rival players.

44.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_032
44.description: Victory is achieved in one of two ways: be the first team to hold a designated number of medals in its collective possession; or be the team holding the most medals when the time limit for the match expires.

45.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_100_032
45.description: Should the time limit expire with both teams holding the same number of medals, the match will enter a two-minute “Sudden Death” period.

46.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_101_032
46.description: The first team to obtain a medal during Sudden Death will win the match.

47.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_033
47.description: Every player receives a number of medals at the beginning of the match, and more medals can be plundered from KO'd opponents.

48.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_034
48.description: When defeated, players will drop half of the medals in their possession. These medals can then be claimed by anyone on the opposing team.

49.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_035
49.description: The more medals a player carries, the more will be dropped upon being KO'd. As victory is determined by the total number of medals held by a team, it is important to consider which team member is the best choice for collecting any dropped medals.

50.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_036
50.description: But be sure to decide quickly: unclaimed medals will vanish after a certain period of time has elapsed, and return to the possession of the original owner.

51.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_100_037
51.description: Want to know whether yer opponent's a bloodthirsty wolf or a pup tremblin' in its own piss? Easy─just check their medals! The more medals they've got, the stronger they are!

52.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_100_038
52.description: In the Feast, participants attempt to seize medals from opposing team members. There is a limit to how many medals one person can possess, and medals seized that exceed this limit will reappear on the battlefield.

53.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_100_039
53.description: Medal limits are determined by role as follows:<hex:02100103>Tanks: 200 / Melee DPS: 175 / Ranged DPS: 140 / Healers: 125

57.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_200_037
57.description: A predator must be lean and fleet to catch its prey! Fatten up on too much flesh, and ye risk becomin' the next meal! So it is in the wild, and so it is here!

58.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_200_038
58.description: Participants who hold 100 or more medals in their possession will be afflicted with the “Heavy Medal” status. While under this status, a participant will receive added damage from attacks.

59.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_200_039
59.description: In contrast, participants who have fewer than 100 medals benefit from the “Light Medal” status. While under this status, a participant will receive reduced damage from attacks.

60.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_200_040
60.description: The strength of these effects increases in proportion to the number of medals the participant possesses above or below the threshold.

61.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_040
61.description: The meat at the Feast is served raw and bloody! If ye want to add a little flavor, then ye'd best get yer paws on the finest spices!

62.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_041
62.description: The supply containers found around the arena contain “kits” that offer a variety of beneficial effects. The effect of each kit can be determined by the appearance of the supply container.

63.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_042
63.description: Target and destroy a supply container to release its contents, then interact with the kit to gain its effects.

64.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_043
64.description: Note that the effect of a kit can only be gained by the team member who inflicts the most damage upon the supply container.

65.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_050
65.description: This is a banquet of blood! Only pups waste their time snappin' and snarlin'─a proper wolf goes straight for the throat!

66.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_051
66.description: During the match, if a certain amount of time elapses without a player being KO'd, then all participants will be afflicted by “Culling Time”─a detrimental status effect that causes players to receive added damage from attacks.

67.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_052
67.description: The amount of extra damage received will continue to rise as time passes. This status will be cleared from all participants upon a player being KO'd.

68.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_060
68.description: After the wolves have feasted, there's naught left but bloodstains and ravaged corpses!

69.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_061
69.description: The scoreboard for the Feast displays player contribution to the battle using three abbreviations: K, D, and A.

70.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_062
70.description: “K” stands for the number of opponents a player has killed; “D” stands for the number of a player's deaths; and “A” represents a player's number of assists in defeating enemies.

71.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_070
71.description: Yer worth as a hunter is measured by the foes ye savage in battle! Let's see how high ye can pile them fang-scored bones!

72.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_071
72.description: A player's PvP rating is a value that represents <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> relative skill compared to other participants of the Feast.

73.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_072
73.description: PvP rating is affected by the outcome of ranked matches─a player's rating will increase upon victory and decrease upon defeat.

74.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_080
74.description: To the fiercest beasts go the choicest spoils! But have ye the stamina to stay ahead of the pack?

75.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_081
75.description: A player's tier represents <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> standing in the hierarchy of the Feast, and is decided by the player's current PvP rating. The higher a player's tier, the better the rewards that can be claimed at the end of a season.

76.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_082
76.description: To move up to the next tier, a player must not only achieve the requisite PvP rating but also win a number of qualifying matches.

77.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_083
77.description: Should a player's PvP rating drop below the minimum required for the current tier, that player will be demoted to the next lower tier.

78.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_090
78.description: The best seat at the Feast is found perched atop a mountain of yer enemies' carcasses!

79.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_091
79.description: Promotion qualifiers are matches that allow players to advance to higher tiers. Participants can only fight in promotion qualifiers once they have reached the requisite PvP rating.

80.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_092
80.description: Once the requisite PvP rating has been reached, players earn the right to fight in up to five promotion qualifiers. At least three of these matches must be won in order to advance to the next tier.

81.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_093
81.description: During this promotion period, all matches marked as “Ranked” in the Duty Finder will be counted as qualifying matches.

82.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_100
82.description: There comes an end to even the most frenzied repast. But when the Feast is over and the table cleared away, will ye be the one wearin' the gore-spattered crown!?

83.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_101
83.description: A “season” refers to the set period within which participants of the Feast must strive to achieve the highest possible PvP rating and tier.

84.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_102
84.description: At the end of each season, players will receive rewards based on their final tier. Participants that fulfill certain conditions will also be eligible for special season bonuses.

85.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_103
85.description: Speak to the quartermaster at the Wolves' Den to learn more about season rewards.

86.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_104
86.description: When a season ends, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>all PvP ratings and tiers will be reset<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. All players begin with zero rating at the start of each new season.

87.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_105
87.description: The Feast is currently in preseason. During this practice period, players can temporarily improve their PvP rating and fight in promotion qualifiers, but no season rewards will be on offer.

88.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_106
88.description: Use this opportunity to hone your skills, and prepare for the first official season of the Feast!

89.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_BERKOEYA_000_110
89.description: The victor earns glory and respect! The loser earns contempt reserved for steaming piles of chocobo dung! Couldn't be any simpler!

90.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_31
90.description: Participating in a match will earn you <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>PvP EXP<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Wolf Marks<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, with a larger amount being awarded to the victors.

91.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_050_31
91.description: By accumulating PvP EXP, you will rise in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>PvP rank<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

92.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_100_31
92.description: Wolf Marks, on the other hand, are a special kind of currency that can be used to purchase certain items found only at the Wolves' Den.

94.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPCOLOSSEUM_00102_SYSTEM_000_32
94.description: You will also receive <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>PvE EXP<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> and <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Allagan tomestones<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> at the end of each match.
